描述_EN: after the abbasid caliphate was established in iraq in ad 750, muslim merchants developed a direct route to china. a glaze was essential as the clay was porous, but the turquoise colourant and the undulating trail of pinched clay ornament were expensive additions to a simple storage jar. storage jars were made in the thousands in the early islamic period. the jar is very similar to a type made in parts of iraq and iran in the later years of sasanian rule (about ad 224 to 631), before the islamic conquest, which continued to be produced. this example may have contained date syrup or another product, and the jar and its contents were exported throughout the world, to east africa, south east asia, china and japan, where shards have been found.
描述_ZN: 公元750年阿巴斯王朝哈里发在伊拉克建立后，穆斯林商人开发了一条直接通往中国的路线。 由于粘土是多孔的，所以上釉是必不可少的，但是绿松石色的着色剂和起伏的捏泥装饰品对一个简单的储存罐来说是昂贵的补充。 在伊斯兰教早期，储存罐的制作数量是成千上万的。 这个罐子与萨珊王朝统治后期（约公元224年至631年）在伊拉克和伊朗部分地区制造的一种类型非常相似，在伊斯兰教征服之前，这种罐子继续被生产。 这个例子可能装的是椰枣糖浆或其他产品，罐子和它的内容物被出口到世界各地，包括东非、东南亚、中国和日本，在那里发现了碎片。
